title: Clank

inlines.v: CLANK, n [See Clang.] The loud, shrill, sharp sound, made by a collision of metallic or other sonorous bodies. CLANK, verb transitive To make a sharp, shrill sound; to strike with a sharp sound; as, the prisoners clank their chains.
